news.headline: Kamara practices again, but Cam Jordan sits out
news.summary: Alvin Kamara practiced Thursday in a limited way as his sore knee gets better before Sunday's opener at Detroit. Cam Jordan did not practice at all with his hurt hamstring, and tight end Oscar Delp and running back Audric Estime sat out too.

news.headline: Travis Etienne will play his first game for the Saints
news.summary: Running back Travis Etienne sat out the preseason, so Sunday at Detroit will be his first game in a Saints uniform. He grew up in Jennings, Louisiana, and ran for more than 1,000 yards in three of his four seasons with Jacksonville.

news.headline: Cam Jordan will miss Sunday; Kamara back at practice
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that Cam Jordan's hurt hamstring will keep him out of the opener at Detroit. Alvin Kamara practiced for the first time since he hurt his knee in August, but he was held to a light workload.

news.headline: Florida's game with Campbell is sold out
news.summary: Every ticket is gone for Saturday afternoon's game in Gainesville. It is the 20th home game in a row the Gators have sold out.

news.headline: Florida will wear blue helmets Saturday
news.summary: The Gators announced Thursday that they will wear blue helmets, orange jerseys and white pants against Campbell. They have not worn the blue helmets since 2020.

news.headline: Sumrall wants a cleaner game from the Gators
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that his defense was not sharp in the 66-21 win over Florida Atlantic. He also said the bad snaps from his center will get fixed before Campbell visits on Saturday.

news.headline: SEC meets but takes no vote on LSU
news.summary: The league's school presidents met by video call Thursday and did not vote on LSU's membership. The SEC said afterward only that the talks will keep going.

news.headline: SEC not expected to vote on removing LSU
news.summary: LSU filled its last two roster spots and told the conference the matter was closed, so the vote is off the agenda for Thursday's meeting. The two former pro players LSU wanted to add cannot join the team this season.

news.headline: LSU tells the SEC it has followed the rules
news.summary: LSU wrote to the conference on Wednesday and said the matter is settled, one day before the league's school presidents meet about it. LSU also said it will not try to stop that meeting.

news.headline: Tulane names a new starting quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that Kadin Semonza will start Saturday against South Alabama. Semonza came off the bench at halftime at Duke and led Tulane's only scoring drive.

news.headline: Tulane's coach says the mistakes can be fixed
news.summary: Will Hall took the blame for the offense after Saturday's 17-3 loss at Duke. Tulane was flagged for 15 penalties, and Hall changed quarterbacks at halftime.

news.headline: Duke beats Tulane 17-3 in the opener
news.summary: Tulane's offense never got going Saturday at Duke and the Green Wave managed only a field goal. Duke running back Nate Sheppard carried the ball 35 times for 227 yards and two touchdowns.
